title: Answer: no theory of measurement, observation reveals causal structure

statements.text: The view takes no position on quantum measurement. Observation through the senses reveals the causal structure of matter, consciousness is known by acquaintance, and no faculty reaches the non-phenomenal nature of matter. Shani and Keppler rely on stochastic electrodynamics, on which every material system is an open stochastic system in contact with the zero-point field.

sources.quote: We know about the causal structure of matter through the way it impacts on our senses
